Desktop shell window; hosts HomePanel and mainloop.

ui_views.description: Data loading and variable configuration stage.
Univariate diagnostics stage with histogram/QQ/boxplot rendering.
Manual and dynamic capping stage with preview charts.
Visible stage but currently disabled in service and UI content.

ui_components.description: Main composite UI controller/view with callbacks, local vars, and stage rendering.
Reusable Matplotlib grid host with resize debounce and cleanup.
Encapsulated 3D cloud widget with toolbar and metadata labels.
Shared visual tokens and Matplotlib style helpers.

plotting_components.description: PyVista pilot adapter currently availability-gated to fallback.

state_modules.description: Mutable workflow state backing current step, cutoffs, domains, dynamic capping.
Large distributed UI state through StringVar/BooleanVar/DoubleVar fields.

services.description: Primary application service for CSV load, config, readiness, EDA/spatial prep, cutoffs, placeholders.
Data prep/statistical helper functions and dataclasses for spatial/swath/variogram payloads.
Session JSONL event logging and export.

domain_modules.description: Core computations: prepare_spatial_sections, prepare_spatial_3d_cloud, compute_swath_series, compute_experimental_variogram.
GeostatsPy import availability adapter for future domain expansion.

persistence_modules.description: Only concrete persistence path found (JSONL logs).
Out-of-GUI git update script for runtime safety.

test_modules.description: Service contract and regression tests (cutoff/readiness/snapshot/domain placeholders).
EDA/spatial payload tests including swath and 3D prep.
AST-based regression tests for UI structure and guardrail strings.
AST-based tests for render hardening and resize debounce signals.

variography_related_modules.description: compute_experimental_variogram and VariogramResult exist but are not wired to UI/service workflow.
Variography tab/button/action placeholders present; no operational view logic.
variography stage exists in readiness and step map, plus variogram_placeholder method only.

risks: HomePanel monolith causes high coupling and difficult feature isolation.
Domain/variography readiness status may mislead because modules are disabled/placeholders.
No formal DTO/schema versioning for analysis payloads.
State duplication across UI vars, workflow_state, and mutable dataframe.
Variogram algorithm is O(n^2) and can become a performance bottleneck.
recommended_next_steps: Define formal VariographyRequest/VariographyResponse contracts and lock them before ticket slicing.
Create dedicated variography application service and keep HomePanel integration thin.
Extract stage-specific UI classes (EDA/Cutoffs/Espacial/Variography) to reduce HomePanel complexity.
Add end-to-end interaction tests for key user flows beyond AST structure checks.
Introduce persisted session/model configuration format for reproducible analytical workflows.
